title: Notice on SK hynix Inc. ADR (SKHYV/​SKHY) on Binance Stocks - 2026-07-10
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.  Fellow Binancians, To expand the range of trading choices offered on  Binance Stocks  and enhance users’ trading experience, Binance will allow users to place  whole-share regular trading hours limit orders  for  SK hynix Inc. ADR  on a  when-issued basis  under the temporary symbol   of  SKHYV  starting from  2026-07-10 09:05 (UTC) . Terms and Conditions: SK hynix is an American Depositary Receipt (ADR). Each SK hynix ADR represents one-tenth (1/10) of one ordinary share of SK Hynix Inc. listed on the Korea Exchange. Holders are subject to a standard ADR fee charged by the depositary bank. You may find more information from the  FAQ . SK hynix Inc. is expected to begin trading on  2026-07-10  on a when-issued basis under the symbol  SKHYV . Trading will close at  2026-07-10 20:00 (UTC) . The symbol is expected to change to  SKHY  and begin trading on a regular-way basis effective  2026-07-13 13:30 (UTC) .  Based on historical Nasdaq behavior for high-profile IPOs, the symbol is  not expected to open  at the usual  13:30 (UTC) . The initial price discovery phase typically lasts for several hours. Orders are queued and will  not  be executed until the market is officially open for  SKHYV . Only limit orders are supported prior to opening cross*. Both Good Till Cancel (GTC) and day orders are supported for limit orders, market orders are  not  supported. *The opening cross is the process by which an exchange (in this case, Nasdaq) matches buy and sell orders to determine the first public trading price of a security. Any unfilled SKHYV orders remaining after the when-issued trading session ends will expire. Limit Up Limit Down (LULD) bands apply to all National Market System (NMS) stocks including IPOs. If the price moves outside the LULD band, trading is paused. When Nasdaq halts  SKHYV or SKHY , regular trading will only resume until Nasdaq lifts the halt. During a halt,  no new orders  can be placed and pending status  market orders will be cancelled , pending status limit order will remain. Partnered brokers may enforce net buy restrictions or caps. In these cases, new buy orders may be rejected or blocked, while risk-reducing sell orders may still be permitted depending on the specific control.  Fully Paid Securities Lending (FPSL) for  SKHY  will be eligible when shares from trades are  fully settled . (T+1 trading day) Trading of the aforementioned new stock(s) is subject to eligibility based on the user's country or region of residence.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.  Thank you for your support!
